name: Generative Art
description: Endless art made by code: flowing lines, orbits, mosaics, waves and growing roots. Tap for a new piece, drag to stir it, save your favourites.
prompt: Generative art made by code: flowing lines, orbits, mosaics, waves and growing roots in several palettes, a new piece on each tap, dragging to stir it, and saving the art as an image.
author: gonzaroman

description_i18n.es: Arte infinito hecho con código: líneas que fluyen, órbitas, mosaicos, ondas y raíces que crecen. Toca para una obra nueva, arrastra para removerla y guarda tus favoritas.
